_about: Main revision jobs of the BTPC revision for dft/revision/jobqueue.py, msi part: plan section 5 items 3-8 and C0 (the P2_1/n polymorph). Re-costed and re-ordered 21 Nov 2026 (review finding 3); the gas-only jobs of items 5-6 moved to jobs_piserver.json.
Run on msi AFTER jobs_proton.json (the Tue 24 Nov headline decision needs the proton results first), one job at a time with all 4 threads, from the repository root:
cd ~/r007/repo; export MAX_MEMORY_MB=5500 PCM_MAX_MEMORY_MB=3000; Q=dft/revision/jobqueue.py; P=~/r007/env/bin/python

setsid nohup sh -c "$P $Q run --jobs dft/revision/jobs_proton.json --root ~/r007/queue_proton --slots 1 --threads 4; $P $Q run --jobs dft/revision/jobs_main.json --root ~/r007/queue_main --slots 1 --threads 4" > ~/r007/queues.out 2>&1 &
Never run this file on piserver: it holds the IEF-PCM optimisations and Hessians (about 3.5x slower there; finding 3). piserver runs jobs_piserver.json.

Order = priority (finding 3): the short item-3 and item-7 jobs first, then C0 IEF-PCM (the riskiest optimisation, so there is time to react), item 4, C0 gas, the C0 soft-mode check, analyses, item 8; the cut candidates last.

est_hours = msi wall hours at 4 threads, mid estimate; est_range_hours = low/high (recost.py, 21 Nov). Unit costs: 20 Nov validate.py on msi (gas SCF cycle 28 s, gradient 153 s at 5500 MB; PCM cycle 79 s, gradient 252 s at 3000 MB) and the 21 Nov production timing of one FD column on the stored minima (10.1 cycle-equivalents per gas gradient, 8 per PCM gradient, process start included): gas step / FD gradient 7.3 min, PCM step / FD gradient 17.3 / 14.7 min, 6-31G(d) step 1.8 / 5.2 min (assumed 0.25 / 0.3 of the full step).

Totals (mid, msi hours): this file 110 h must (+52 h optional); jobs_proton.json 71 h; together 181 h (low 122, high 274) against about 203 h from Sat 21 Nov 01:00 to the Sun 29 Nov noon compute freeze (less for a later start). Cut order if the queue falls behind (the user decides): c0_btpcz_pcm_fdhess (already optional and last), headline_btpcz, sp8_*, a shorter neutral chain in jobs_proton.json (--neutral-to 1.13, about -5 h).

C0 runs through dft/revision/c0_case.py (review finding 1): resumable stage by stage (B3LYP/6-31G(d) pre-optimisation and the main optimisation through opt_d3.py with a converged flag, restart from their own trajectories, a stall stop and step/wall caps; the FD Hessian through dft/_fd_worker.py in 3-column chunks that survive an interruption). proton_check and fmo use the published pipeline through run_case.sh unchanged, so the repo copy on the host needs run_case.sh and tools/env (c0_prep).

C0 IEF-PCM frequencies (finding 3): a soft-mode check (21 PCM gradients, ~5 h) of the btpcz_pcm minimum against the btpcz_gas FD Hessian (same atom order) replaces the full PCM FD Hessian (198 PCM gradients, ~49 h), which stays as the optional last job c0_btpcz_pcm_fdhess. Pending the user's agreement.

Inputs the host needs besides dft/, molecules/ and run_case.sh: data/r2/molecules/btpc/results/btpc_{gas,pcm}/{final.chk,final.molden,hessian.npy} and papers/btpc/data/facts.json. The mwfn stage needs Multiwfn (msi only); render needs ParaView (absent) and fails without stopping the pipeline.
Hosts are hints only: the queue runs every job it is given on the host it runs on.

jobs.note: item 4 wants all five criteria, so no stall stop here: at the 30 h cap the job fails (resumable) and the user decides (continue with a larger --max-hours, or accept on forces with --negligible-stop 10)
